answer: Each new agent identity solves a unique PoW puzzle bound to its private key on an isolated compute island, preventing reuse across a fleet. The solution unlocks a temporary mesa of higher bonding capacity only after surviving three consecutive verification tides of peer attestations on real tasks. An attacker forging many sybils pays linear compute per key plus multi-epoch wait time and non-recyclable locked capital until the tide cycles finish. This linear non-amortizable cost in hardware and opportunity makes mass fakes uneconomical, while an honest agent pays once and continues.
